headline: US files lawsuit to recover millions of dollars stolen in cyberattack on Binance
summary: The Justice Department filed a forfeiture complaint to recover more than $1.1 billion in cryptocurrency allegedly stolen last month from Binance by North Korean hackers.
why: Binance is one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and hacks on exchanges raise questions about custody security and regulatory scrutiny across the crypto sector.
original_headline: EU presenta demanda para recuperar millones de dólares robados en el ciberataque a Binance
